units.source_text: 到了九月里，妹尼僧又要赴初濑进香了。

en.t: When the ninth month came, the nun, Ukifune's younger sister, again planned to go on pilgrimage to Hatsuse.

units.source_text: 她多年以来寂寞无聊，思念爱女无时或忘。

en.t: For many years she had lived in loneliness and tedium, never for a moment forgetting the daughter she loved.

units.source_text: 如今得到了这个与亲生女儿无异的美人，以慰暮年，

en.t: Now that she had gained this beautiful woman, no different from a daughter of her own, as a comfort in her old age,

units.source_text: 她认为是初濑观世音菩萨保佑之故，不胜欣喜。

en.t: she believed it was thanks to the protection of Kannon Bodhisattva of Hatsuse, and was overjoyed.

units.source_text: 为此再去进香，表示答谢。

en.t: For that reason she would go again on pilgrimage, to offer her thanks.

units.source_text: 她对浮舟说道：“你和我同去吧。

en.t: She said to Ukifune, "Come with me.

units.source_text: 各处佛菩萨虽然同一，但到初濑进香，特别灵验。

en.t: The buddhas and bodhisattvas everywhere are one and the same, but a pilgrimage to Hatsuse is especially efficacious.
There are very many examples of it."
She strongly urged Ukifune to go with her.

units.source_text: 但浮舟想道：“从前母亲与乳母也这样说，常常带我到初濑去进香。

en.t: But Ukifune thought, "In the past, my mother and my nurse said the same thing, and often took me to Hatsuse on pilgrimage.

units.source_text: 然而并无效验，连求死也不能如意，

en.t: Yet there was no sign of grace; even my wish to die could not be fulfilled,

units.source_text: 却遭逢了世无其例的苦难，真使我异常痛心。

en.t: and instead I met with suffering without equal in the world, which has caused me extraordinary pain.

units.source_text: 如今跟着这些素不相识的人登此旅途，有何意义呢？”

en.t: What meaning is there now in setting out on this journey with people I do not know at all?"

units.source_text: 她心中恐惧，不肯随行，但口上并不坚拒，

en.t: She was afraid in her heart and unwilling to go along, but she did not firmly refuse aloud,

units.source_text: 只是答道：“我总觉心绪恶劣。

en.t: and merely answered, "I feel that my spirits are somehow unwell.

units.source_text: 远道旅行，深恐途中不便，为此有所顾虑。”

en.t: Since it is a long journey, I am deeply afraid there may be difficulties on the way, and that is why I hesitate."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧知道她是个非常胆小的人，也不勉强她同行。

en.t: The nun knew that Ukifune was an extremely timid person, and did not force her to accompany them.

units.source_text: 浮舟的习字纸中夹着一首诗：

en.t: Among Ukifune's calligraphy practice papers, a poem was tucked away:
